choices.simplified: 一个大人跟一个小孩一共三百元。
choices.pinyin: Yí ge dàrén gēn yí ge xiǎohái yígòng sān bǎi yuán.
choices.english: One adult and one child cost 300 altogether.

choices.traditional: 這個活動是在星期六的上午。
choices.simplified: 这个活动是在星期六的上午。
choices.pinyin: Zhège huódòng shì zài xīngqíliù de shàngwǔ.
choices.english: This activity is on Saturday morning.

choices.traditional: 小孩不跟大人一起來，也可以參加。
choices.simplified: 小孩不跟大人一起来，也可以参加。
choices.pinyin: Xiǎohái bù gēn dàrén yìqǐ lái, yě kěyǐ cānjiā.
choices.english: Children can join without coming with an adult.

questions.why: 200元 + 100元 = 300元 altogether (一共). The class is in the afternoon (下午), not the morning, and children must come with an adult (要跟大人一起來).

prompt.english: A mom takes her two children to join in. How much is it for the three of them altogether?

questions.why: One adult is 200元 and each child 100元: 200 + 100 + 100 = 400.

versions.alt: A sunny animal farm by a small river: a father has brought his son, a boy of about nine, and his younger daughter, a little girl of about five. By the river a tall brown horse stands next to two white sheep. The boy holds out a red apple to the horse; the girl holds a red apple of the same size and laughs at exactly three chickens, each one fully visible. Under a tree, exactly two pigs of the same size are asleep. There are no other chickens or pigs.

prompt.traditional: 哥哥手裡拿著一個＿＿，他想給馬吃。
prompt.simplified: 哥哥手里拿着一个＿＿，他想给马吃。

answer.traditional: 哥哥手裡拿著一個蘋果，他想給馬吃。
answer.simplified: 哥哥手里拿着一个苹果，他想给马吃。
answer.pinyin: Gēge shǒu lǐ názhe yí ge píngguǒ, tā xiǎng gěi mǎ chī.
answer.english: The older brother is holding an apple; he wants to give it to the horse.

questions.why: In the picture the boy holds out a red apple (蘋果) to the horse. There is no banana (香蕉) or bread (麵包) in the picture.

answer.pinyin: Zhèlǐ de jī bǐ zhū duō.
answer.english: There are more chickens than pigs here.

questions.why: Count them: three chickens (雞) and two pigs (豬), so 雞比豬多. 比豬少 says the opposite, and 跟豬一樣多 would need the same number.

answer.traditional: 妹妹一看到雞，就很高興。
answer.simplified: 妹妹一看到鸡，就很高兴。
answer.pinyin: Mèimei yí kàndào jī, jiù hěn gāoxìng.
answer.english: As soon as the little sister sees the chickens, she is happy.

questions.why: 一……就…… means the second thing comes right after the first: as soon as she sees the chickens, she is happy. 再 (next; again) and 太 (too) do not pair with 一 like this.

versions.alt: A sunny animal farm by a small river: a father has brought his son, a boy of about nine, and his younger daughter, a little girl of about five. By the river a tall brown horse stands next to two white sheep. The boy holds out a red apple to the horse; the girl holds a red apple of the same size and laughs at exactly three chickens, each one fully visible. Under a tree, exactly two pigs of the same size are asleep. There are no other chickens or pigs.

answer.pinyin: Hé pángbiān yǒu liǎng zhī yáng.
answer.english: There are two sheep by the river.

questions.why: Animals like sheep take 隻: 兩隻羊. 條 is for snakes and rivers, and 張 is for paper and tables.

prompt.traditional: 爸爸＿＿著哥哥跟妹妹來看動物。
prompt.simplified: 爸爸＿＿着哥哥跟妹妹来看动物。

answer.traditional: 爸爸帶著哥哥跟妹妹來看動物。
answer.simplified: 爸爸带着哥哥跟妹妹来看动物。
answer.pinyin: Bàba dàizhe gēge gēn mèimei lái kàn dòngwù.
answer.english: Dad has brought the brother and sister to see the animals.

questions.why: You 帶 (take along) people: 帶著哥哥跟妹妹. 拿 is for things in your hand, and 穿 is for clothes.

prompt.traditional: 樹下的這隻豬跟那隻豬＿＿大。
prompt.simplified: 树下的这只猪跟那只猪＿＿大。

answer.traditional: 樹下的這隻豬跟那隻豬一樣大。
answer.simplified: 树下的这只猪跟那只猪一样大。
answer.pinyin: Shù xià de zhè zhī zhū gēn nà zhī zhū yíyàng dà.
answer.english: This pig under the tree is as big as that one.

questions.why: 跟…一樣大 means as big as: the two pigs under the tree are the same size, so not 不一樣. 一起 (together) cannot stand before 大 like this.

passage.traditional: 今天是我的生日。我是兔年{1}的，所以媽媽送我一個兔子蛋糕，我一看{2}很喜歡。我在台灣住{3}三年了，這是我在台灣過的第三個生日。朋友說兔子很可愛，在十二生肖裡很{4}。
passage.simplified: 今天是我的生日。我是兔年{1}的，所以妈妈送我一个兔子蛋糕，我一看{2}很喜欢。我在台湾住{3}三年了，这是我在台湾过的第三个生日。朋友说兔子很可爱，在十二生肖里很{4}。
passage.pinyin: Jīntiān shì wǒ de shēngrì. Wǒ shì tù nián chūshēng de, suǒyǐ māma sòng wǒ yí ge tùzi dàngāo, wǒ yí kàn jiù hěn xǐhuān. Wǒ zài Táiwān zhù le sān nián le, zhè shì wǒ zài Táiwān guò de dì sān ge shēngrì. Péngyǒu shuō tùzi hěn kě'ài, zài shí'èr shēngxiào lǐ hěn shòu huānyíng.
passage.english: Today is my birthday. I was born in the Year of the Rabbit, so Mom gave me a rabbit cake, and I loved it the moment I saw it. I have lived in Taiwan for three years now; this is my third birthday in Taiwan. My friends say rabbits are cute and very popular among the twelve zodiac animals.

questions.why: 兔年出生的 means born in the Year of the Rabbit.
一看就很喜歡: 一 … 就 … means the writer loved it the moment they saw it.
住了三年了: the second 了 shows the writer still lives here, three years so far.
很受歡迎 means very popular. 一樣 would need 跟 and a second thing to compare.

passage.traditional: 我以前不知道自己屬什麼，所以{1}去問了媽媽。{2}我屬羊！我哥哥屬蛇，他的生肖{3}我的不一樣。十二生肖裡，每一種動物都{4}一年，真有意思。
passage.simplified: 我以前不知道自己属什么，所以{1}去问了妈妈。{2}我属羊！我哥哥属蛇，他的生肖{3}我的不一样。十二生肖里，每一种动物都{4}一年，真有意思。
passage.pinyin: Wǒ yǐqián bù zhīdào zìjǐ shǔ shénme, suǒyǐ gāngcái qù wèn le māma. Yuánlái wǒ shǔ yáng! Wǒ gēge shǔ shé, tā de shēngxiào gēn wǒ de bù yíyàng. Shí'èr shēngxiào lǐ, měi yì zhǒng dòngwù dōu dàibiǎo yì nián, zhēn yǒu yìsi.
passage.english: I didn't know my zodiac sign before, so just now I went and asked Mom. It turns out I'm a Goat! My older brother is a Snake; his sign is different from mine. In the zodiac, each animal stands for one year. How interesting.

questions.why: 剛才 means just now: the writer went and asked Mom a moment ago.
原來 introduces what the writer found out from Mom: it turns out they are a Goat (屬羊).
A 跟 B 不一樣 means A is different from B. 一樣 is already in the sentence after 不.
每一種動物都代表一年: each animal stands for (代表) one year.

text.traditional:
元真：
這個星期天我想去參觀科學展，妳要不要一起去？從捷運站走路五分鐘就到了。聽說去看的人很多，買票要排隊排很久，所以我們早一點去吧。九點在捷運站門口見，好嗎？
宜文
text.simplified:
元真：
这个星期天我想去参观科学展，你要不要一起去？从捷运站走路五分钟就到了。听说去看的人很多，买票要排队排很久，所以我们早一点去吧。九点在捷运站门口见，好吗？
宜文
text.pinyin: Yuánzhēn: Zhège xīngqítiān wǒ xiǎng qù cānguān kēxué zhǎn, nǐ yào bu yào yìqǐ qù? Cóng jiéyùn zhàn zǒulù wǔ fēnzhōng jiù dào le. Tīngshuō qù kàn de rén hěn duō, mǎi piào yào páiduì pái hěn jiǔ, suǒyǐ wǒmen zǎo yìdiǎn qù ba. Jiǔ diǎn zài jiéyùn zhàn ménkǒu jiàn, hǎo ma? Yíwén
text.english: Yuanzhen: This Sunday I'd like to visit the science exhibition. Do you want to come? It's a five-minute walk from the MRT station. I hear lots of people go, and the ticket line is long, so let's go early. Shall we meet at nine at the MRT station entrance? Yiwen

prompt.pinyin: Nǎ yí ge shì duì de?
prompt.english: Which one is true?

choices.pinyin: páiduì mǎi piào yào děng hěn jiǔ
jiǔ diǎn zài kēxué zhǎn ménkǒu jiàn
choices.english: they meet at nine at the exhibition entrance

choices.pinyin: qù kàn de rén bù duō

questions.why: Yiwen writes 買票要排隊排很久: the ticket line is long. They meet at the MRT station entrance (捷運站門口), not at the exhibition, and many people go (去看的人很多).

text.traditional:
中明：
我今天問了老闆，他說我們麵包店週末還需要一個人，一天只工作兩個小時。如果你想來，明天下課以後跟我一起去見老闆吧。
國安
text.simplified:
中明：
我今天问了老板，他说我们面包店周末还需要一个人，一天只工作两个小时。如果你想来，明天下课以后跟我一起去见老板吧。
国安
text.pinyin: Zhōngmíng: Wǒ jīntiān wèn le lǎobǎn, tā shuō wǒmen miànbāo diàn zhōumò hái xūyào yí ge rén, yì tiān zhǐ gōngzuò liǎng ge xiǎoshí. Rúguǒ nǐ xiǎng lái, míngtiān xiàkè yǐhòu gēn wǒ yìqǐ qù jiàn lǎobǎn ba. Guó'ān
text.english: Zhongming: I asked my boss today. He says our bakery still needs one more person on weekends, and it's only two hours a day. If you'd like to come, go with me to meet the boss tomorrow after class. Guo'an

prompt.traditional: 中明什麼時候可以去見老闆？
prompt.simplified: 中明什么时候可以去见老板？
prompt.pinyin: Zhōngmíng shénme shíhòu kěyǐ qù jiàn lǎobǎn?
prompt.english: When can Zhongming go to meet the boss?

questions.why: Guo'an writes 明天下課以後跟我一起去見老闆: tomorrow after class (下課以後), not before class (上課以前). 今天 is when Guo'an asked the boss.
